title: Just Juice Bar Range Pineapple 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Pineapple from Just Juice's Bar Range of Nic Salt e-liquids offers a lush, vibrant pineapple flavour. Each puff delivers the sweet, sunny tang of ripe pineapple, laced with a gentle streak of cool ice, creating a vape experience that's authentically fruity and refreshing. This e-liquid is a celebration of tropical flavour, perfect for vapers looking for an exotic escape. This premium e-liquid's 60PG/40VG blend is expertly crafted to strike the ideal balance between robust flavour and satisfying cloud production. The use of nic salt formulation makes it perfectly suited for classic e-cigarette starter kits and MTL (mouth-to-lung) pod devices, providing an optimal choice for those new to vaping or looking for the quick, satisfying nicotine hit that nic salts deliver. Nicotine salts offer a smoother throat hit and a faster absorption into the bloodstream than traditional freebase nicotine, delivering almost instant relief from nicotine cravings. This makes Just Juice's Bar Range particularly appealing for those seeking a potent, yet silky smooth vaping experience. Inspired by the intensely satisfying flavours synonymous with the most popular disposable vapes, the Just Juice Bar Range of Nic Salt E-liquids includes both timeless classics and intriguing new concoctions. All Just Juice e-liquids are designed to be long-lasting, less allergenic, and gentler on the throat, ensuring a premium vaping experience with every puff. Please Note : All flavours in the Just Juice Bar Range feature a subtle hint of ice to enhance the flavour profile.
